verdict.rationale: The docs say every flow starts with a trigger followed by actions that run when the flow is activated. The product also connects 760+ apps and positions itself as an open-source Zapier replacement, which strongly implies triggers from events in connected apps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific app-event triggers named in the story (new record, message, email, form submission), and independent or hands-on confirmation that event triggers fire reliably.
